what_it_does: Improves large language model generation of Verilog hardware description code by using speculative decoding with syntactically-aligned tokenization. Traditional tokenizers split Verilog into subword pieces that obscure logical structure; this approach breaks the code at syntactically significant boundaries instead. This enables the model to generate Verilog faster and with higher quality, addressing problems with poor tokenization that arise because Verilog's specialized syntax is underrepresented in typical language model training data.
